Finding R2 (Important, blocks merge): the CHG-20261015-007 Chromium regression imports app build output (apps/web/tests/clock-client.spec.ts:9). The root typecheck script builds only packages/** and the engine before typechecking every workspace (package.json:20), so on a fresh checkout apps/match-service/dist is absent and the web typecheck fails. Local suites (Codex RUN112, re-audit RUN116) passed because earlier builds left that folder in place. RUN-20261015-124 reproduces the hosted error locally by setting the folder aside (expected failure, exit 2) and restores it.

Director decision recorded 2026-10-16T01:30:42.756Z: 'Fix both'. One small Codex round fixes R2 (the CI import) and R1 (a waiting player's opening concession takes the timed reservation) with an opening-phase regression; then this reviewer re-checks, runs hosted CI, publishes and fast-forwards main. Main stays at 775994a.
